intro: Three months ago Dwarkesh, who has been posting incredible blogs and episodes about RL, posted a framing question for his video essay on RLVR which upset a lot of Computer Use folks:

We are no strangers to learning in public and are no strangers to the stress of getting things wrong when you have a big platform. However, we were at Anthropic for the Computer Use launch , there for Claude Cowork with the first big podcast on it, organized the first Computer Use track at AIE presenting the state of the art, and were close to the OpenAI-Sky Software acquisition that now powers the complete domination of computer use that Codex enjoys today. This is why we’re excited to bring you today’s first guest, Ari Weinstein , cofounder of Sky and now leading all the amazing CUA progress that casuals might miss:

Ari explains why Computer Use is now “180 degrees different” from where it was months ago, how agents are learning to debug and recover from failures, why combining screenshots with accessibility data, the DOM, Playwright, and generated code changes the speed equation, and why the next frontier is making agents literally superhuman at using software.

In the second half, Nikunj Handa from OpenAI’s API team breaks down the new developer stack: async tool calling, mid-turn steering, WebSockets, UltraFast inference, the Decisions API, prompt caching, pre-warming, compaction, and the Agents API . Given that we were the first Jev podcast , we particularly focus on the unusually fast sprint on the Decisions API:
And why it is just a Luna wrapper for now but the team is motivated and egoless enough to clone what they consider to be good patterns.

summary.one_liner: OpenAI 團隊拆解 Computer Use 的進展與全新 API 架構，涵蓋 Dots、非同步工具調用與 Decisions API。

topics.title: Dots 與雲端虛擬電腦
topics.body: Ari 介紹個人助理產品 Dots 為每個 Agent 配備獨立的雲端 Linux 虛擬電腦。不同於過往僅能操控瀏覽器或本地端，現在可直接運行完整桌面應用程式與瀏覽器。藉由讓 Agent 使用為人類設計的軟體，大幅擴展了委派任務的廣度。

topics.title: Computer Use 翻轉與自我除錯
topics.body: Ari 指出 Computer Use 相較幾個月前已有 180 度轉變。過去模型容易卡在任務中途，現在則具備強大的除錯、重試與自省能力。同時模型會主動編寫 JavaScript 程式碼一次執行多步操作，並結合截圖、DOM 與 accessibility 樹等多元介面，讓速度提升 7 倍。

topics.title: App Shots 與閉環軟體測試
topics.body: App Shots 讓模型不只獲取像素畫面，還能同時抓取完整的文字、metadata 與無障礙架構資料。此外，Ari 強調 Computer Use 最有價值的場景是讓 Agent 自行測試剛寫好的程式碼，完成軟體開發生命週期的閉環，讓人類不再只是 Agent 的 QA。

topics.title: GPT-6 非同步與雙向架構
topics.body: Nikunj 說明 GPT-6 帶來的 API 進展，包含 async function calling 與 mid-turn steering。模型在執行耗時的工具調用時無需暫停推理，能持續思考或中途注入新指令。底層則借助 WebSockets 達成雙向通訊，並搭配 UltraFast 推理大幅壓低延遲。

topics.title: Decisions API 的極速原型
topics.body: OpenAI 受到 Jev 啟發，內部團隊僅花約一週便基於 Luna 模型權重打造出 Decisions API。該 API 專注於極速分類與並行批量輸出，不依賴龐大推理成本，未來預期可搭配 GPT Live 實現反應極為靈敏的語音操控與工具調用。

topics.title: Prompt 快取機制與長上下文壓縮
topics.body: 針對長期運行的 Agent 執行緒，Nikunj 介紹了 30 分鐘保證與預覽中的 12 小時長效 prompt caching，並支援 cache pre-warming。在面對百萬 token 上限時，API 提供伺服器端自動 compaction 或開放 /compact 手動調用，保留靈活的 context 壓縮控制權。

insights.title: 採用 App Shots 多模態上下文優於純截圖
insights.body: 純視覺截圖會遺失連結目標、截斷文字等資訊；在 Agent 架構中同時注入 accessibility 樹與 DOM 結構，並讓模型生成腳本批次執行，能顯著降低滾動重試次數與 token 消耗。

insights.title: 導入非同步工具調用與中途引導
insights.body: 設計複雜 Agent 工作流時，善用 WebSockets 實現 async tool calling 與 mid-turn steering，讓模型在等待外掛或 API 回應時持續推理，並可依中間狀態動態插入修正指令。

insights.title: 運用 Cache Pre-Warming 降低常駐 Agent 成本
insights.body: 在長期對話或高重複 prompt 的場景中，工程師應建立 cache-aware 架構，透過預先付費 pre-warm 快取並結合伺服器端自動 compaction，有效維持低延遲與大幅壓低讀取費用。

summary.one_liner: The OpenAI team breaks down advances in Computer Use and the new API architecture, covering Dots, asynchronous tool calling, and the Decisions API.

topics.title: Dots and Cloud Virtual Computers
topics.body: Ari introduces the personal assistant product Dots, which equips each Agent with an isolated cloud Linux virtual computer. Unlike previous approaches that could only control browsers or run locally, it can now directly run full desktop applications and browsers. By enabling Agents to use software designed for humans, the scope of delegable tasks is massively expanded.

topics.title: Computer Use Transformation and Self-Debugging
topics.body: Ari notes that Computer Use has undergone a 180-degree shift compared to a few months ago. Previously, models would easily get stuck midway through tasks; now they feature robust debugging, retry, and introspection capabilities. Meanwhile, the model proactively writes JavaScript code to execute multi-step actions in one go, combining multimodal interfaces like screenshots, the DOM, and accessibility trees to deliver a 7x speedup.

topics.title: App Shots and Closed-Loop Software Testing
topics.body: App Shots enables the model to capture not just raw pixels, but also full text, metadata, and accessibility tree data simultaneously. Moreover, Ari emphasizes that the highest-value scenario for Computer Use is enabling Agents to test code they just wrote, closing the loop on the software development lifecycle so humans no longer serve merely as QA for Agents.

topics.title: GPT-6 Asynchronous and Bidirectional Architecture
topics.body: Nikunj explains the API advances brought by GPT-6, including async function calling and mid-turn steering. The model does not need to pause inference while executing time-consuming tool calls; it can continue thinking or have new instructions injected mid-turn. Under the hood, WebSockets enable bidirectional communication, paired with UltraFast inference to drastically reduce latency.

topics.title: Rapid Prototyping of the Decisions API
topics.body: Inspired by Jev, an internal OpenAI team spent just about a week building the Decisions API based on Luna model weights. Focusing on ultra-fast classification and parallel batch output without heavy inference overhead, it is expected to integrate with GPT Live in the future to enable ultra-responsive voice control and tool calling.

topics.title: Prompt Caching Mechanisms and Long-Context Compaction
topics.body: For long-running Agent threads, Nikunj introduced the 30-minute guaranteed and preview 12-hour extended prompt caching, with support for cache pre-warming. When bumping against million-token limits, the API offers server-side automatic compaction or a manual /compact endpoint, retaining flexible control over context compression.

insights.title: Adopting App Shots Multimodal Context Over Pure Screenshots
insights.body: Pure visual screenshots lose information like link targets and truncated text; injecting accessibility trees and DOM structures simultaneously into the Agent architecture, while having the model generate scripts for batch execution, significantly reduces scroll retries and token consumption.

insights.title: Adopt Asynchronous Tool Calling and Mid-Turn Steering
insights.body: When designing complex Agent workflows, leverage WebSockets to achieve async tool calling and mid-turn steering, allowing the model to continue reasoning while awaiting plugin or API responses, and dynamically inject corrective instructions based on intermediate states.

insights.title: Leverage Cache Pre-Warming to Lower Resident Agent Costs
insights.body: In scenarios with long-running conversations or highly repetitive prompts, engineers should build cache-aware architectures. By pre-warming caches and combining them with server-side automatic compaction, one can effectively maintain low latency and drastically slash read costs.
